rationale: Independent reading: held EO 12240 (45 FR 64545) amends EO 12202 (funding sentence in 1-303; 1-402 'The Committee shall terminate on September 30, 1981.'; membership five to six). Pure amendment of EO 12202. Held EO 12379 (47 FR 36099) sec. 22: 'Executive Order No. 12202, as amended, establishing the Nuclear Safety Oversight Committee, is revoked.' Revocation of the parent as amended ends all of EO 12240 (whole_via_parent, stated openly). Refutation attempts: right instrument and section; no savings clause. Own term: the substituted Sept. 30, 1981 term ran out earlier; this only moves the end earlier, and the producer says so. D6: EO 12399 sec. 4(c) revokes EO 12202 again as a terminated committee (confirms); a corpus search finds 'Nuclear Safety Oversight' only in 12202, 12240, 12399 (and 12379 split across lines); nothing extends or revives the Committee. No later event ignored. NO upheld; first-end date (1981 term vs 1982 revocation) left to lifecycle review. D6 answer: no later event ignored; own term Sept. 30, 1981 noted as possibly earlier end.
